subject: Quick check: fit after our discovery — feedback + next step?
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Ortiz <caroline.ortiz@halcyon.ai>, Daniel Foster <dfoster@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + recommended next step (Redwood x Halcyon discovery)

Hi Caroline / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today — quick recap and a suggested next step so we can keep momentum: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: reduce per-query inference cost by ~40% while keeping tail latency under 300ms for search-ranking workloads.
- Data residency: model serving must run in a private VPC for PII-sensitive telemetry.
- Volume: ~800k queries/day currently, spiking to 2.5M during promos.

What Redwood can do (short list)
- Hosted evaluation on our Dedicated tier with VPC peering + KMS integration.
- Quantization and KV caching profile that usually yields the cost/latency improvements we discussed.
- Pilot scope: 2-week perf run, 3 endpoints (reranking, embeddings, generative summaries).

Suggested next step
1) Approve a short pilot statement of work (attached) — approves infra/timebox and success criteria.
2) Kickoff: 30–45m technical onboarding with Marissa and infra next week.

Attachments: redwood-discovery-deck-halcyon.pdf, example-sow-template.docx

If this lines up, I can send a one-page SOW and propose times for onboarding. If not, a quick note on where we missed the mark would be super helpful.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Ortiz <caroline.ortiz@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Daniel Foster <dfoster@halcyon.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: any initial thoughts on fit?

Caroline —

Circling back on the note below and the attached SOW. I know timing can be tight — just checking whether this is still something you want to pursue in Q2 (pilot in May) or better to revisit next quarter. 

If it's helpful I can:
- Narrow the SOW to a single endpoint pilot to shorten the timeline
- Share a short checklist for your security team to speed VPC onboarding

No rush — a one-line direction is great.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Caroline Ortiz <caroline.ortiz@halcyon.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Foster <dfoster@halcyon.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: any initial thoughts on fit?

Vivek —

Apologies for the radio silence; travel and launch prep ate the week. Quick note: the direction is promising, but we need a clearer picture of data-handling in the pilot (what stays in our VPC vs logs sent to Redwood) and a ballpark for pilot cost. Can you send that and a single-endpoint SOW?

I can block 30m on Thurs to review.

—Caroline
Head of Search, Halcyon.ai
caroline.ortiz@halcyon.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Ortiz <caroline.ortiz@halcyon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Foster <dfoster@halcyon.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: any initial thoughts on fit?

Thanks Caroline — great to hear. Attaching a 1-page single-endpoint SOW and a short note on data flows. High level: 

- Pilot infra: model-serving runs in your VPC via our Private deployment (no model artifacts leave your VPC).
- Logs: telemetry for performance (latency/cpu/gpu) can be sent to Redwood telemetry; we can redact or keep logs in your logging account per the SOW.
- Ballpark pilot cost: $18k for a 2-week dedicated pilot (includes infra & engineering support).

I’ve attached: redwood-single-endpoint-sow-halcyon.pdf and data-flow-one-pager.pdf (stubs attached below).

Proposed meeting: Thu 20 Apr, 11:00–11:30 PT — is that still okay?

—
Vivek

Attachment stubs: redwood-single-endpoint-sow-halcyon.pdf (PDF), data-flow-one-pager.pdf (PDF)

From: Daniel Foster <dfoster@halcyon.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Caroline Ortiz <caroline.ortiz@halcyon.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: any initial thoughts on fit?

Vivek / Caroline —

11:00 PT works for me. Caroline, bringing infra lead; Vivek, please share the single-endpoint SOW link and the data flow doc in the calendar invite so we have them in the meeting.

See you both on the call.

—Daniel
Sr. Engineering Manager, Halcyon.ai
